To improve, Decathlon Sports should invest in employee training programs and consider hiring more experienced staff to better handle the demands

dnyansadhana-college.pos_feedback: Dnyansadhana College offers an excellent education supported by helpful staff, experienced faculty, and modern facilities, making it a top choice among students and parents alike.

food-town-restaurant.pos_feedback: Food Town Restaurant offers delicious, tasty, and quickly served meals in a nice ambiance, earning high praise from locals for its excellent service.
food-town-restaurant.neg_feedback: Food Town Restaurant serves half-cooked meals with tiny portions, leaving customers unsatisfied; they should improve cooking times and increase serving sizes to enhance customer experience.

golds-gym.pos_feedback: Golds Gym offers a clean, well-equipped, motivating atmosphere, and helpful trainers that make your workout experience truly enjoyable.
golds-gym.neg_feedback: Golds Gym needs to address its poor hygiene, inadequate maintenance, staff negligence, and incompetent trainers to improve its reputation and attract more members.

hotel-malvan-restaurant.pos_feedback: Hotel Malvan Restaurant offers delicious, authentic, and high-quality food along with excellent service, making it a standout choice among local eateries.
hotel-malvan-restaurant.neg_feedback: Hotel Malvan Restaurant needs to address its unfriendly and rude staff, poor service, unsafe environment, and lack of hygiene to improve customer satisfaction and trust.

jupyter-hospital.neg_feedback: Jupyter Hospital offers subpar care due to its long wait times, unresponsive staff, and poor communication, leading to a disappointing patient experience that needs urgent improvement.
